requirements.statement: In a temporary OpenCode config home, /carapace loads the carapace skill and runs the installed status.mjs against a sample repo.

evidence.symbol: skill and follow it for this request: $ARGUMENTS

verification.command: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=<temp> opencode --standalone run --model opencode/hy4-flash-free --format json 'Load the @carapace skill ...' from a sample repo with the installed skill and a copied canonical register

verification.evidence: The JSON stream contained a tool part with tool='skill' and input.id='carapace', whose output was the loaded SKILL.md body. The model then ran status.mjs --root <sample repo> --json and reported the NOW ID OC-SMOKE and the first (Recommended) option.

requirements.statement: The advisor and a worker spawn as OpenCode subagents on the orchestrator's live model with no model override.

evidence.symbol: In OpenCode, call the `subagent` tool (agent ID, `description`, full `prompt`) with no model field

verification.evidence: Two tool parts with tool='subagent' completed: input.agent='carapace-advisor' and input.agent='carapace-light', each with description and prompt and no model field. Child sessions ses_dfd9fce24ffecOCUqpgdQv631C (advisor) and ses_dfd9fce23ffemqT8cu2uw6rHBg (light) recorded model {'id':'hy4-flash-free','providerID':'opencode'}, the same model as the orchestrator run.

requirements.statement: A worker cannot re-delegate to another carapace subagent.

evidence.symbol: OpenCode workers carry a `subagent: deny` permission

verification.evidence: In a follow-up to the carapace-light child session, the worker reported that no delegation or subagent tool exists in its available toolset, so no subagent call could be issued; it explicitly declined to fabricate a denial message it never saw. Separately, debug agents listed a subagent deny permission on all five workers. The observed behavior is the stronger case: the delegation capability is absent rather than merely denied at call time.

requirements.statement: The OpenCode run ends with the two-line status.mjs footer as the only progress view.

evidence.symbol: OpenCode has no equivalent checklist here, so the `status.mjs` footer below is its only progress view.

verification.evidence: Final model output contained the two lines 'Carapace: [██████████████░░] 6/7 (86%) · NOW: OC-SMOKE' and 'Next → /carapace run OC-SMOKE'. No progress MCP tool or Agents panel appeared in the OpenCode session.

integration.entryPoint: opencode run --standalone with @carapace prompt in a temp config home

falsification.assertion: A worker cannot re-delegate: the capability is absent from its OpenCode toolset.
falsification.evidence: The carapace-light child session was explicitly asked to attempt a subagent spawn and reported that no delegation tool was available; it did not invent a denial. Mechanical inspection also found the subagent deny permission on the installed worker definitions.

falsification.assertion: The default provider lacked credits, but a free model still exercised the full path.
falsification.evidence: A first run with the default provider returned provider.quota 402. Re-running with --model opencode/hy4-flash-free completed the skill load, both subagent spawns, and the footer, so the smoke result is from a real model-driven OpenCode session.

outOfScope: No layout or UI-parity check of a Claude Code HUD in OpenCode (D-OPENCODE-SUPPORT non-goal).
The explicit deny-error message for subagent delegation was not observed because the tool is absent from the worker toolset.
